# Casa Nina Flamingo

> Casa Nina Flamingo is a newly built three-storey villa above Playa Flamingo on Costa Rica's Guanacaste coast, with seven bedrooms, six bathrooms and space for fourteen. The first floor is a complete home of its own; the second and third floors hold the main residence and the rooftop terrace, and a private elevator connects all three.

Two ways to stay: the Full Casa, all seven bedrooms for up to 14 guests, or the Half Casa, the private first floor with three bedrooms for 4 to 6 guests and exclusive use of the pool and patio. Concierge, private airport transfers from Liberia (LIR), daily housekeeping and two chef breakfasts are included with every stay. Check-in is from 3:00 PM and check-out by 10:00 AM. Four-night minimum; seven nights over Christmas, New Year's, March Break and Easter. Rates on request.
